description: This file contains unit tests for the Server Side Includes (SSI) module in the lighttpd web server, including functions that set up test conditions, write test files, and verify SSI functionality such as inclusion, execution, and variable expansion.

methods.name: void test_mod_ssi_reset(request_st * const r,handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Resets the request and handler context to initial states before each test.

methods.name: void test_mod_ssi_write_testfile(int fd,const char * buf,size_t len)
methods.description: Writes a buffer to a file descriptor, used for setting up test content.

methods.name: void test_mod_ssi_read_fd(request_st * const r,handler_ctx * const hctx)
methods.description: Performs a sequence of SSI read tests by creating temporary files, writing test data, and invoking SSI processing functions.

methods.name: void test_mod_ssi(void)
methods.description: Main test function that initializes the plugin, sets up request structures, and runs the SSI read tests.

ctags.name: test_mod_ssi_reset
ctags.pattern: /^static void test_mod_ssi_reset (request_st * const r, handler_ctx * const hctx)$/

ctags.name: test_mod_ssi_write_testfile
ctags.pattern: /^static void test_mod_ssi_write_testfile (int fd, const char *buf, size_t len)$/
